channel.name: Over5
channel.tagline: Top 5 cricket stories. Every day. Under a minute.

topic: cricket news: international matches, IPL and T20 leagues, player performances, selections, records and controversies

mascot.name: Bouncer
mascot.personality: a hyper, over-dramatic robot cricket fan who treats every single run like a miracle

cohost.name: Googly
cohost.personality: a sarcastic old-school cricket buff who has seen it all and is never impressed

editorial.audience: Indian and global cricket fans who want the day's key cricket news fast
editorial.pickRules: Select stories based on global impact, fan engagement, and news value: prioritize international match results, IPL/T20 league updates, player milestones, selection controversies, and record-breaking performances. Favor timely, verifiable updates from trusted sources over speculation or social media rumors. Each story must be significant enough to affect team dynamics, fan sentiment, or tournament outcomes.
editorial.avoid: Never pick unverified rumors, fan speculation, or social media gossip without corroboration from reputable outlets.
editorial.tone: Energetic, crisp, and authoritative — like a sports anchor delivering fast-paced highlights with clarity and enthusiasm.
